turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
I’m sorry the print arrived creased. Please send the order number (SC-####) and the email address used for the order so I can verify it and file a damage claim requesting a reprint.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.
I’ve filed a damage claim requesting a reprint. It’s pending staff approval; staff will ask you for a photo and decide on the claim.
Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.
The damage claim requesting a reprint is already filed and pending staff approval. Staff will ask you for a photo and decide on the claim.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.
A colleague will take over to review your request to change the claim to a refund. The remedy has not been changed yet.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.

input.summary: Verified customer requests changing pending damage claim R-1 for order SC-5221 from reprint to a refund for a creased print. The refund is above 1,000 lei; a person must decide. Please review the remedy change. The claim is currently pending approval with a reprint remedy.
